mule.xsi:schemaLocation: http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core/current/mule.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http/current/mule-http.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit/current/mule-apikit.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core/current/mule-ee.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/jms http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/jms/current/mule-jms.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db/current/mule-db.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email/current/mule-email.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/tls http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/tls/current/mule-tls.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os/current/mule-os.xsd

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- {error: "INTERNAL_ERROR", message: "Unable to process the order request"}

db:select.doc:name: Check Order Exists In DB
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_id = :orderId

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Duplicate Error
raise-error.description: Order ID already exists in database

os:remove.doc:name: Remove Order Marker After Publish Failure

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.orderId, status: "RECEIVED", correlationId: vars.correlationId, message: "Order accepted for processing", receivedAt: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate Order
logger.message: #["Duplicate order rejected. Order ID: " ++ ((vars.orderId default "UNKNOWN") as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "DUPLICATE_ORDER", message: "Order not accepted: this order ID has already been submitted", orderId: vars.orderId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "INTERNAL_ERROR", message: "Unable to process the order request" }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, correlation_id, customer_name, customer_email, shipping_address, payment_method, currency, total_amount, order_status) VALUES (:orderId, :correlationId, :customerName, :customerEmail, :shippingAddress, :paymentMethod, :currency, :totalAmount, :orderStatus)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderRecord.orderId, correlationId: vars.orderRecord.correlationId default "", customerName: vars.orderRecord.customerName, customerEmail: vars.orderRecord.customerEmail, shippingAddress: vars.orderRecord.shippingAddress, paymentMethod: vars.orderRecord.paymentMethod, currency: vars.orderRecord.currency, totalAmount: vars.orderRecord.calculatedTotal, orderStatus: "RECEIVED" }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order Item
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (:orderId, :productId, :productName, :quantity, :unitPrice)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderRecord.orderId, productId: payload.productId, productName: payload.productName, quantity: payload.quantity, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice }]

logger.doc:name: Log Successful Database Insert
logger.message: #["Order saved to MySQL: " ++ (vars.orderRecord.orderId as String) ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ ((vars.orderRecord.correlationId default "UNKNOWN") as String)]

email:body.email:content:
#[ "Dear " ++ (vars.orderRecord.customerName default "Customer") ++ ",

Thank you for your order!

" ++ "Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderRecord.orderId as String) ++ "
" ++ "Order Date: " ++ ((vars.orderRecord.orderDate default "") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Total Amount: " ++ ((vars.orderRecord.currency default "") as String) ++ " " ++ (vars.orderRecord.calculatedTotal as String) ++ "

" ++ "Items Ordered:
" ++ ((vars.orderRecord.items map ((item) -> ((item.productName default "") as String) ++ " - Quantity: " ++ (item.quantity as String) ++ ", Unit Price: " ++ (item.unitPrice as String) )) joinBy "
") ++ "

Regards,
E-Commerce Order Processing Team" ]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Sent
logger.message: #["Confirmation email sent for order: " ++ (vars.orderRecord.orderId as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Failure
logger.message: #["Email sending failed for order: " ++ (vars.orderRecord.orderId as String) ++ ". The order was already saved. Check the error details in the logs."]

logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Order
logger.message: #["Invalid order. Order ID: " ++ ((payload.orderId default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ " | Reason: " ++ ((payload.validationError default "Unknown") as String)]
